provenance.labels: Synthetic community-static-v4 winner tuples. Partial analytic inverse constructs legal candidates.
provenance.prediction: No solver winner, target label or pixel-overlap score enters prediction. Ranker learns candidate preference.
provenance.fitting: Ranker fits ambiguous candidates only, squared-error binary labels; each candidate receives equal weight. Cases with more alternatives receive more weight. Single-candidate cases bypass learning.
provenance.selection: Two fixed ranker capacities, validation tuple fidelity only; ties choose smaller. Refit train+validation. Residual comparator fixed at 32 depth-4 rounds, refit on identical settings. Calibration excluded from fitting.
provenance.freshness: All 596 earlier setting groups excluded. Seed and capacities frozen before new scores. Earlier observed shifted scopes inform the design; fresh setting triples, not a novel shift family.
provenance.dependence: Interior and exterior share 80 challenge triples; they are not independent replications.
provenance.scope: Synthetic solver fidelity, not native rendering validation. Feature ranges do not establish distribution support.
